wikimedia-acct_creation_throttle_hit:
Booqdayaasha wiki-ga ee adeegsanaya cinwaanka IP-gaaga ayaa abuuray {{PLURAL:$1|1 koonto|$1 koonto}} $2 ee la soo dhaafay, taasoo ah tirada ugu badan ee la oggol yahay muddadan.
Natiijadaas awgeed, booqdayaasha adeegsanaya IP-kan ma abuuri karaan koontooyin dheeraad ah xilligan.

Haddii aad joogto dhacdo diiradda lagu saarayo wax ku biirinta mashaariicda Wikimedia, fadlan eeg [[m:Mass account creation#Requesting_temporary_lift_of_IP_cap|Codsiga si ku-meelgaar ah loo qaado xadka IP-ga]] si loo xalliyo arrintan.
wikimedia-acct_creation_throttle_hit-tem: Waxaan si ku meelgaar ah u xaddidnay wax ka beddelka adigoo aan soo gelin oo ka imanaya goobtaada. Fadlan [{{fullurl:Special:CreateAccount|campaign=temp-rate-limit}} samee akoon] si aad u wax ka beddesho, ama mar kale isku day waqti dambe.
wikimedia-prefs-user-downloaddata-help-m: Waxaad booqan kartaa bogga doorbidkaaga ee [[m:Special:CentralAuth/$1|mashaariicda kale ee Wikimedia ee aad wax ku biirisay]] si aad uga soo dejiso xogta koontadaada mashaariicdaas.
wikimedia-centralauth-login-error-locked: Koontadan waa [[m:Special:MyLanguage/Global locks|si caalami ah loo qufulay]]. {{GENDER:$1|Adigu}} ma awoodi doontid inaad gasho wax wiki ah oo Wikimedia ah. Fadlan [[m:Special:Contact/stewards|la xiriir wakiillada]] haddii {{GENDER:$1|aad}} qabto su'aalo.

Xogtan waxaa loo ururiyaa loona adeegsadaa si waafaqsan [https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Policy:Privacy_policy siyaasadda asturnaanta] iyo [https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Policy:Access_to_nonpublic_personal_data_policy siyaasadda gelitaanka xogta shaqsiyeed ee aan la shaacin]. Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ka eeg https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:CheckUser/Client_Hints

wikimedia-checkuser-tempaccount-enable-p: Ka hor inta aadan shidin dejimahan, waa inaad akhridaa oo aad oggolaataa "[https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Policy:Access_to_temporary_account_IP_addresses Siyaasadda Gelitaanka Cinwaannada IP-ga ee Koontooyinka Ku meelgaarka ah]". Gaar ahaan: Waa inaadan marin, isticmaalin ama shaacin macluumaadka ku saabsan cinwaannada IP-ga ee koontooyinka ku-meelgaarka ah, haddii aysan si macquul ah lagama maarmaan u ahayn baarista ama tallaabo ka qaadista burburin, xadgudub, spam, dhibaateyn, hab-dhaqan khaldan, iyo jebinta kale ee siyaasadaha Wikimedia Foundation ama kuwa bulshada. Haddii aad la wadaagto macluumaadkan dadka kale, waa inaad ka taxaddartaa halka iyo sida aad u wadaagayso, waana inaad ka saartaa marka aysan mar dambe lagama maarmaan ahayn in la arko. Isticmaalayaasha kale ee leh gelitaanka IP-ga koontooyinka ku-meelgaarka ah waxay arki doonaan inaad shiday doorashadan.
wikimedia-checkuser-temporary-accounts-o: Si loo ilaaliyo asturnaanta isticmaalayaasha, {{SITENAME}} mar dambe si dadweyne uma muujinayo [https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Policy:Privacy_policy/Glossary_of_key_terms#ip-address cinwaannada IP-ga] ee tifaftirayaasha soo galida ka bax. Taa beddelkeeda, tifaftirayaasha aan soo gelin waxaa la siin doonaa magacyo si otomaatig ah loo sameeyo oo ku xiran [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Help:Temporary_accounts akoonno ku-meelgaar ah], waxaana cinwaannadooda IP-ga kaliya arki kara [https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Policy:Wikimedia_Access_to_Temporary_Account_IP_Addresses_Policy shaqaale iyo isticmaalayaal u baahan inay arkaan] si wax looga qabto burburin iyo hab-dhaqan xadgudub ah. Marka akoon ku-meelgaar ah loo sameeyo tifaftiraha aan soo gelin, cookie ayaa lagu kaydin doonaa biraawsarkiisa. Akoonkaas ku-meelgaarka ah ayaa markaas [https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Policy:Privacy_policy#your-public-contribs loo nisbeeyn doonaa dhammaan wax-ka-beddellada xiga], xitaa haddii cinwaanka IP-ga uu isbeddelo.

Qalabka [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Trust_and_Safety_Product/IP_Info Macluumaadka IP-ga] (Macluumaadka IP-ga) waxa uu u fududeeyaa maamulayaasha, la dagaallamayaasha burburinta iyo isticmaaleyaasha khibradda leh inay helaan xog ku saabsan cinwaannada IP-ga iyaga oo aan si toos ah u arkin cinwaannada IP-ga laftooda.

Isticmaaleyaasha buuxiya [https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Legal:IP_Information_tool_guidelines#Requirements_for_access shuruudaha gelitaanka] waxay IP Info ka hawlgelin karaan dookhyadooda. Marka la hawlgeliyo, IP Info pop-up ayaa ka soo muuqan doona agagaarka akoonnada ku-meelgaarka ah iyo cinwaannada IP-ga ee hore. Xogta IP-ga sidoo kale waxa lagu soo bandhigi doonaa bogga wax ku biirinta.

{{int:checkuser-temporary-accounts-onboarding-dialog-ip-reveal-step-content-base}} Ikhtiyaar ahaan, isticmaalayaashu sidoo kale si otomaatig ah ayay u muujin karaan cinwaannadan IP-ga marka ay la tacaalayaan burburinta.
wikimedia-checkuser-temporary-account-au: Si otomaatig ah ayaa loo laalay sababo la xiriira firfircooni la’aan; eeg [[wikimedia:Special:MyLanguage/Policy:Wikimedia_Access_to_Temporary_Account_IP_Addresses_Policy#Other_users|siyaasadda gelitaanka]] si aad u hesho faahfaahin
wikimedia-checkuser-global-contributions: Natiijooyin lama helin oo la jaanqaadaya weydiinta. Cinwaankan IP-ga laga yaabo inuusan lahayn wax wax ka beddel ah ama uu leeyahay kaliya [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Special:MyLanguage/Trust_and_Safety_Product/Temporary_Accounts/FAQ#Legacy_IP_edits wax-ka-beddelladii IP-ga hore]. Ka raadi [https://guc.toolforge.org/?user={{urlencode:$1}} GUC] ama [https://xtools.wmcloud.org/globalcontribs/{{urlencode:$1|PATH}} XTools GC] si aad u aragto wax-ka-beddellada IP-ga hore. Intaa waxaa dheer, waxaa laga yaabaa inaadan [https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Access_to_temporary_account_IP_addresses#Minimum_requirements_for_access buuxin shuruudaha ugu yar] ee lagu oggolaanayo in la arko cinwaannada IP-ga ee ay adeegsadaan akoonnada ku meelgaarka ah.
wikimedia-checkuser-investigateblock-war: Waxaad ku dhowdahay inaad isla mar ahaantaas xannibto labada akoon iyo cinwaannada IP-ga adigoo isticmaalaya isla sababta ka dib markaad isticmaashay xogta CheckUser. Tani waxay jebin kartaa [https://foundation.wikimedia.org/wiki/Policy:Access_to_nonpublic_personal_data_policy Siyaasadda gelitaanka xogta shaqsiyeed ee aan la shaacin]. Ma hubtaa inaad sidaas sameyso?
wikimedia-checkuser-suggestedinvestigati:

wikimedia-pt-movepage-page-count-limit: '''Boggan la turjumi karo wuxuu ka kooban yahay in ka badan $1 {{PLURAL:$1|bog|bogag}}.''' wikimedia-rest-module-site.v1-desc:
Waxay bixisaa macluumaad ku saabsan goobaha mashruuca Wikimedia, oo ay ku jiraan khariidadaha bogagga. Si looga hortago isticmaal xadgudub ah oo loo xaqiijiyo isticmaal cadaalad ah ee kaabayaasha, gelitaanka dhammaadka API-kan waxaa lagu xaddiday kooxo isticmaalayaal gaar ah. Macluumaad dheeraad ah oo ku saabsan cidda geli karta API-kan, eeg  [CDN
/Backend_api/Sitemap_access](https://wikitech.wikimedia.org/wiki/CDN/Backend_api/Sitemap_access) ama la xiriir [mailto:bot-traffic@wikimedia.org bot-traffic@wikimedia.org].
